topic_title: Planning Commission of India & Five-Year Plans (Part 1/2)

intro_payload.title: 📊 Indian Economic Planning Masterclass (Part 1)
intro_payload.subtitle: Historical Roots to the 12th Five-Year Plan
learning_outcomes: Pre-independence planning initiatives (Visvesvaraya, NPC 1938, Bombay Plan, Gandhian, People's & Sarvodaya Plan)
Establishment & composition of Planning Commission (15 March 1950)
Comprehensive breakdown of all 12 Five-Year Plans and Plan Holidays

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, India mein economic planning 1950 se shuru nahi hui! Iska historical background 1934 se start hota hai. M. Visvesvaraya ne apni book 'Planned Economy for India' (1934) mein pehli baar 10-year plan ka proposal diya tha.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Acha! To Visvesvaraya ji ko 'Father of Indian Economic Planning' bhi kaha jata hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Iske baad 1938 mein Congress President Subhash Chandra Bose ne 'National Planning Committee' (NPC) banayi, jiske Chairman bane Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Exams ke 4 crucial pre-independence plans yaad rakho:
1. Bombay Plan (1944) — 8 industrialist (J.R.D. Tata, G.D. Birla etc.)
2. Gandhian Plan (1944) — Shriman Narayan Agarwal
3. People's Plan (1945) — M.N. Roy (Marxist approach)
4. Sarvodaya Plan (1950) — Jaiprakash Narayan (JP)!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, JP Narayan wala question BPSC mein bar-bar aata hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Exact! Sarvodaya Plan (Jan 1950) par hi aage chalkar Planning Commission ki broad philosophy rely karti hai.

quiz_payload.question: 'Sarvodaya Plan' (1950) kiske dwara formulate kiya gaya tha?
quiz_payload.explanation: Sarvodaya Plan January 1950 mein Jaiprakash Narayan dwara prastut kiya gaya tha. M.N. Roy ne 'People's Plan' (1945) aur S.N. Agarwal ne 'Gandhian Plan' (1944) design kiya tha.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Planning Commission 15 March 1950 ko K.C. Neogy Committee ki recommendations par bana. Ye ek Extra-Constitutional (Non-Constitutional) aur Non-Statutory body thi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, Non-Statutory ka kya matlab hota hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Matlab ye Parliament ke kisi Act ke dwara nahi, balki Union Cabinet ke executive resolution se banayi gayi thi. Iska direct mention Constitution ke kisi article mein nahi hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: National Development Council (NDC / Rashtriya Vikas Parishad) 6 August 1952 ko banayi gayi. Iska kaam tha Five-Year Plans ko final approval dena aur Centre-State coordination banana. K. Santhanam ne isko 'Super Cabinet' kaha tha!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: NDC mein kaun-kaun log shamil hote the?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Prime Minister (Chairman), All Union Cabinet Ministers, All States ke Chief Ministers, UTs ke Administrators/Lt. Governors aur Planning Commission ke members.

quiz_payload.question: National Development Council (NDC) ka gathan kab hua tha?
quiz_payload.explanation: NDC ka gathan 6 August 1952 ko hua tha. Iska mukhya karya Five Year Plans ko anumodan (approval) dena tha.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: India ne Five-Year Plan model USSR (Soviet Union) ke Gosplan se adopt kiya tha. Total 12 Five-Year Plans execute hue (1951–2017). Beech mein kuch interruptions (Plan Holidays, Rolling Plans) bhi aaye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, kya hum saare plans ke models aur core objectives sequentially padhenge?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan, BPSC aur SSC dono mein economic models (Harrod-Domar, Mahalanobis, Gadgil, etc.) aur schemes ke launch dates seedhe aate hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: First Plan (1951–56): Harrod-Domar Model par aadharit. Focus: Agriculture, Price Stability, Irrigation. Target Growth: 2.1%, Achieved: 3.6% (Bada success!).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Is plan mein kaunse major projects banaye gaye the?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bhakra-Nangal, Damodar Valley (DVC), aur Hirakud Dams. Saath hi 2 October 1952 ko 'Community Development Programme' (CDP) launch hua!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Second Plan (1956–61): P.C. Mahalanobis Model (4-sector model). Focus: Rapid Industrialisation & Heavy Industries. Goal: 'Socialistic Pattern of Society' establish karna (1955 Avadi Session).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Isme kaunse steel plants lagaye gaye the?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bhilai (USSR help), Rourkela (Germany help), aur Durgapur (UK help) Steel Plants. Atomic Energy Commission aur TIFR ko boost mila.

quiz_payload.question: Second Five-Year Plan (1956-61) kis arthshastri ke model par aadharit thi?
quiz_payload.explanation: Second Plan Prof. P.C. Mahalanobis ke 4-sector model par aadharit thi, jisme heavy aur basic capital goods industries par zor diya gaya.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Third Plan (1961–66): John Sandy aur Sukhamoy Chakravarty Model (Gadgil Yojana se bhi prabhavit). Target: Self-reliant aur self-generating economy. Target: 5.6%, Achieved: 2.84% (Heavy Failure).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Itna bada fail hone ka kya reason tha Sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 1962 Sino-Indian War, 1965 Indo-Pak War, aur 1965-66 ka severe drought! Isi plan ke dauran 1964 mein Bokaro Steel Plant (USSR help) aur 1965 mein FCI & CACP shuru hue.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Plan Holiday (1966–69): 3 saal tak 3 Annual Plans lagaye gaye. Economy ruin ho chuki thi, rupee ka devaluation hua (June 1966). Lekin isi dauran M.S. Swaminathan ke netritva mein 'Green Revolution' (Harit Kranti) shuru hui!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab Plan Holiday mein hi Green Revolution ki shuruaat hui!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul! High Yielding Varieties (HYV seeds), fertilizers aur tubewell irrigation ka massive adoption hua.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Fourth Plan (1969–74): Gadgil Mukherjee Formula par aadharit. Objective: 'Growth with Stability' aur 'Progressive Achievement of Self-reliance'.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Is plan mein Indira Gandhi government ke major events kya the?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 14 Commercial Banks ka Nationalisation (1969), 1971 Indo-Pak War (Bangladesh Liberation), Drought Prone Area Programme (DPAP - 1973), aur Smiling Buddha Nuclear Test (May 1974)!

quiz_payload.question: 14 Pramukh Commercial Banks ka Rashtriyakaran (Nationalisation) kis Five-Year Plan ke dauran hua?
quiz_payload.explanation: 19 July 1969 ko 14 banks ka nationalisation hua, jo Fourth Five-Year Plan (1969-74) ke antargat aata hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Fifth Plan (1974–79): D.D. Dhar Model. Main Slogan: 'Garibi Hatao' (Poverty Eradication) aur 'Atmanirbharta'. Isme 'Minimum Needs Programme' (MNP - 1974) aur 20-Point Programme (1975) launch hue.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, kya ye plan 1979 tak poora chala tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nahi! 1977 mein Janata Party government aayi aur Morarji Desai ne is plan ko 1978 mein hi (1 saal pehle) terminate kar diya.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Rolling Plan (1978–80): Gunnar Myrdal ke concept par D.T. Lakdawala dwara design kiya gaya. Isme fixed 5 saal ke bajaye har saal plan ko revise kiya jata tha. 1980 mein Congress wapas aayi aur Rolling Plan band kar diya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Gunnar Myrdal ki koi famous book hai kya Sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! 'Asian Drama', jisme unhone developing nations ke liye Rolling Plan suggest kiya tha.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Sixth Plan (1980–85): Direct attack on poverty. Target: 5.2%, Achieved: 5.7%. Major institutions: NABARD establish hua (12 July 1982 - B. Sivaraman Committee), EXIM Bank (1982), IRDP, NREP, TRYSEM programs expand hue.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Isme aur banks ka nationalisation bhi hua tha na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan, 1980 mein 6 aur commercial banks ko nationalise kiya gaya.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Seventh Plan (1985–90): Pranab Mukherjee model / Wage-Goods Model influence. Slogan: 'Food, Work and Productivity'. Modern technology aur computerisation par zor.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Major schemes kaun si thi 7th plan ki?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Jawahar Rozgar Yojana (JRY - 1989), SEBI ka establishment (1988), aur SPEED Post (1986) shuru hua.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Annual Plans (1990–92): Political instability aur BoP (Balance of Payment) crisis ke karan 8th plan delay hua. Forex reserves sirf 2-3 hafton ke bache the. India ne apna gold pledge kiya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Isi crisis se bahar nikalne ke liye LPG reforms aaye the na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Sahi! 24 July 1991 ko New Economic Policy (LPG - Liberalisation, Privatisation, Globalisation) launch hui.

quiz_payload.question: NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development) ki sthapna kis Five-Year Plan ke dauran hui thi?
quiz_payload.explanation: NABARD ki sthapna 12 July 1982 ko Sixth Five-Year Plan (1980-85) ke antargat B. Sivaraman Committee ki sifarish par ki gayi thi.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Eighth Plan (1992–97): John W. Miller Model. Focus: Human Resource Development (Education, Health, Employment). India WTO ka founding member bana (1 Jan 1995). Target 5.6%, achieved 6.8%!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Is plan mein kaunsi major schemes start hui thi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana (PMRY - 1993), Mid-Day Meal Scheme (15 August 1995), aur Mahila Samriddhi Yojana.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ninth Plan (1997–2002): Theme: 'Growth with Social Justice and Equity'. 50th year of Independence par launch hua. 1997 East Asian Financial Crisis aur 1998 Pokhran-2 sanctions ka impact pada. Growth: 5.4% (Target: 6.5%).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Is dauran infrastructure mein kya bada kaam hua?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Golden Quadrilateral (Swarna Chaturbhuj) aur Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY - Dec 2000) shuru hui!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Tenth Plan (2002–07): Target: 8.0%, Achieved: 7.6%. Objective: Per capita income ko 10 saal mein double karna, poverty ratio 5% kam karna. Governance aur State-level targets ko alag se monitor kiya gaya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: MGNREGA act isi plan mein pass hua tha na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul! NREGA Act 2005 pass hua aur 2 Feb 2006 se implement hua. Bharat Nirman programme (2005) bhi isi plan ka hissa tha.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Eleventh Plan (2007–12): Theme: 'Towards Faster and More Inclusive Growth'. Model prepared by C. Rangarajan. Achieved Growth: 8.0% (Fastest ever across full plans, despite 2008 Global Financial Crisis!).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Inclusive growth ka actual matlab kya tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Vikas ka fayda sabhi tabqo (SCs, STs, OBCs, Minorities, Women) tak pahunchna. Right to Education (RTE Act 2009) aur National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM) isi me aaye.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Twelfth Plan (2012–17): India ki LAST Five-Year Plan! Theme: 'Faster, Sustainable and More Inclusive Growth'. Target: 8.0%. Last Deputy Chairman the Montek Singh Ahluwalia. 2014 mein dissolution ke baad 2017 mein ye technically complete hui.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: 11th aur 12th ke theme mein difference kya hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 12th mein 'Sustainable' word add kiya gaya tha — environment aur long-term resilience par focus!

Mahalanobis | Heavy Industries | Bhilai, Rourkela, Durgapur
Chakravarty/Gadgil | Self-reliance | War & Drought (Failure)

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: BPSC/UPSC Special Concept: Gadgil Formula (1969). States ko Central Assistance (grants aur loans) distribute karne ke liye banaya gaya. Isme Population (60%), Per Capita Income (20%), Tax Effort/Performance (10%), aur Special Problems (10%) weightage tha.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Isme aage chalkar koi changes hue the?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan, 1991 mein Pranab Mukherjee ne ise revise kiya ('Gadgil-Mukherjee Formula'), jisme Special Category States (SCS) ke liye 30% fund alag reserve kiya gaya.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Special Category Status (SCS) 5th Finance Commission (1969) ke recommendation par shuru hua. Criteria: Hilly terrain, low population density/tribal share, strategic border location, economic/infra backwardness, non-viable state finances.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Bihar bar-bar Special Status ki maang kyun karta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Kyunki SCS milne se Centrally Sponsored Schemes mein 90% Grant aur sirf 10% State share lagta hai (Normal states mein 60:40 ya 50:50 hota hai). Halanki 14th Finance Commission ke baad SCS band kar diya gaya.

quiz_payload.question: Gadgil Formula ka mukhya prayojan (primary objective) kya tha?

options.text: Rajyon ko Kendriya Sahayata (Central Assistance) aavantit karna
Green revolution ke targets set karna

quiz_payload.explanation: Gadgil Formula (1969) Planning Commission dwara states ko Central Plan Assistance aavantit (allocate) karne ke liye use kiya jata tha.

quiz_payload.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Indian Planning:
1. National Development Council (NDC) was established by an Act of Parliament in 1952.
2. The concept of Rolling Plan was introduced during the Janata Party government in 1978.
3. The slogan 'Garibi Hatao' was integrated into the Fourth Five-Year Plan document.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
quiz_payload.explanation: Statement 1 is WRONG (NDC was created by an executive resolution, not an Act). Statement 2 is CORRECT (Janata Party under Morarji Desai introduced Rolling Plan). Statement 3 is WRONG ('Garibi Hatao' was central to the Fifth Five-Year Plan, although politically raised in 1971 elections).

quiz_payload.question:
Which of the following pairs of Plans and their respective Growth Models/Themes is/are correctly matched?
1. First Plan — Harrod-Domar Model
2. Second Plan — P.C. Mahalanobis Model
3. Eighth Plan — John W. Miller Model
4. Eleventh Plan — Faster, Sustainable and More Inclusive Growth
quiz_payload.explanation: 1, 2, and 3 are correctly matched. Pair 4 is INCORRECT because 'Sustainable' was added in the 12th Plan theme; the 11th Plan theme was 'Towards Faster and More Inclusive Growth'.

quiz_payload.question:
Match List-I (Institutions/Events) with List-II (Five Year Plan Periods):
(a) Community Development Programme — (1) Plan Holiday
(b) Green Revolution Launch — (2) 1st FYP
(c) Steel Plants (Bhilai, Durgapur) — (3) 6th FYP
(d) Establishment of NABARD — (4) 2nd FYP

Choose the correct code:
quiz_payload.explanation: CDP: 1952 (1st Plan); Green Revolution: 1966-67 (Plan Holiday); Steel Plants: 1956-61 (2nd Plan); NABARD: 1982 (6th Plan).

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Planning Commission leadership facts for SSC/BPSC:
• 1st Chairman: Jawaharlal Nehru
• Last Chairman: Narendra Modi (2014)
• 1st Deputy Chairman: Gulzarilal Nanda
• Last Deputy Chairman: Montek Singh Ahluwalia
• Famous Deputy Chairmen: Dr. Manmohan Singh, Pranab Mukherjee, Jaswant Singh, K.C. Pant.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Deputy Chairman ka rank kya hota tha protocol mein?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Cabinet Minister ke barabar ka status aur rank hota tha!

quiz_payload.question: Planning Commission of India ke FIRST Deputy Chairman kaun the?
quiz_payload.explanation: First Deputy Chairman Gulzarilal Nanda the. Chairman Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru the.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Planning Commission par 3 main criticisms the:
1. Top-Down Approach: Delhi mein baith kar gaon ke liye policy banana bina ground reality samjhe.
2. One-size-fits-all: Bihar aur Kerala ki needs alag hain, par scheme ek hi thop di jaati thi.
3. Discretionary Fund Allocation: Political bias ke arop lagte the.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab states ke paas policy tailor karne ki azadi nahi thi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Sahi pakde! Isi wajah se 15 August 2014 ko Red Fort se PM Narendra Modi ne isko replace karne ka ailaan kiya.

revision_points.point: Planning Commission & NDC dono non-statutory aur extra-constitutional the.
Total 3 Plan Holidays (1966-69), 1 Rolling Plan (1978-80), aur 2 Annual Plans (1990-92).
11th Five-Year Plan recorded highest average GDP growth (8.0%).
3rd Plan (due to twin wars and severe drought).
Finance Commission (Art 280) is Constitutional; Planning Commission was NOT.

quiz_payload.question: Which Five-Year Plan in India was terminated one year before its scheduled completion period?
quiz_payload.explanation: Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974-79) was terminated in 1978 by the Janata Party Government, making its effective duration only 4 years.

quiz_payload.question: BPSC Special: In the context of Indian planning, who among the following was the author of 'Planned Economy for India' (1934)?
quiz_payload.explanation: Sir M. Visvesvaraya published 'Planned Economy for India' in 1934, laying down the earliest framework for state planning.

milestone_payload.completed_topic: Foundations, NDC & Complete Five-Year Plans Era (1950–2014)
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Sensational work! You have completely mastered pre-independence planning, NDC, all 12 Five-Year Plans, and high-yield PYQ traps! Now move to Part 2 for NITI Aayog, Indices, and Bihar-Specific Planning!

cards.topic_title: NITI Aayog, Indices & Bihar State Planning (Part 2/2)

intro_payload.title: 🚀 NITI Aayog & Bihar State Planning (Part 2)
intro_payload.subtitle: New Paradigm of Cooperative Federalism & State Execution

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
1 January 2015 ko Cabinet resolution se NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) bana. Ye 7 Pillars of Effective Governance par based hai:
1. Pro-people, 2. Pro-activity, 3. Participation, 4. Empowering, 5. Inclusion of all, 6. Equality, 7. Transparency.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: NITI Aayog ka core nature kya hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ye Government ka premier policy 'Think Tank' hai jo directional aur policy inputs deta hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
NITI Aayog Composition exam ke liye rat lo:
• Chairperson: Prime Minister
• Vice-Chairperson: Appointed by PM (Rank: Cabinet Minister)
• CEO: Appointed by PM for fixed tenure (Rank: Secretary to GoI)
• Governing Council: All State CMs + Delhi & Puducherry CMs + J&K LG + Other UT LGs.
• Regional Councils: Specific inter-state issues solve karne ke liye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, pehle Vice-Chairperson aur CEO kaun the?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 1st Vice-Chairperson: Arvind Panagariya; 1st CEO: Sindhushree Khullar.

quiz_payload.question: NITI Aayog ke FIRST Vice-Chairperson kaun the?
quiz_payload.explanation: Arvind Panagariya NITI Aayog ke pehle Vice-Chairperson the (January 2015 to August 2017).

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Five-Year Plans ko replace karke NITI Aayog ne 3-tier planning framework laya:
1. 15-Year Vision Document (Long-term national goals)
2. 7-Year National Strategy Document (Mid-term strategy)
3. 3-Year Action Agenda (Operational short-term goals).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Pehla 3-Year Action Agenda kab se kab tak tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 2017-18 se 2019-20 tak. Isne 12th Plan ke officially end hone ke baad planning system sambhala.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
NITI Aayog do principles par chalta hai:
1. Cooperative Federalism: Centre aur States barabar partner hain (Governing Council ke through).
2. Competitive Federalism: States ke beech swasth competition karwana through index rankings (jaise SDG Index, Innovation Index, Water Index)!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Index ranking se states ko kya motivation milta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Best practices identify hoti hain aur backward states reforms adopt karne ke liye push hote hain.

quiz_payload.question: NITI Aayog dwara Five-Year Plans ke sthan par apnaye gaye framework mein 'Action Agenda' kitne varsho ke liye hota hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: NITI Aayog ne 15-Year Vision, 7-Year Strategy aur 3-Year Action Agenda ka framework apnaya hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
NITI Aayog ka Atal Innovation Mission (AIM) schools aur colleges mein entrepreneurship aur innovation promote karta hai. Iske components hain:
• Atal Tinkering Labs (ATLs) — School level par STEM skills
• Atal Incubation Centres (AICs) — Startups support karne ke liye
• Mentor India Network.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Schools mein ATL labs SSC aur BPSC dono me puchha gaya hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan, ATL 6th se 12th class ke students ke liye innovative mindset cultivate karta hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Aspirational Districts Programme (ADP) January 2018 mein launch hua. Desh ke 112 most backward districts ko transform karna iska target tha. Core themes: Health & Nutrition, Education, Agriculture & Water Resources, Financial Inclusion, Basic Infrastructure.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Isme Bihar ke kitne districts select hue the?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: ⭐ BPSC Special: Bihar ke total 13 Districts ADP mein included hain (jaise Katihar, Begusarai, Sheikhpura, Gaya, Banka, etc.)! Ab 2023 se Aspirational Blocks Programme (ABP) bhi launch ho chuka hai.

quiz_payload.question: ⭐ NITI Aayog ke 'Aspirational Districts Programme' (ADP) mein Bihar ke kitne zile (districts) shamil hain?
quiz_payload.explanation: NITI Aayog ke Aspirational Districts Programme mein Bihar ke 13 aakankshi zile (districts) shamil kiye gaye hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
NITI Aayog UN ke 17 SDGs mein se 16 goals par states ko rank karne ke liye 'SDG India Index' nikalta hai. 4 Categories hoti hain:
1. Aspirant (0–49)
2. Performer (50–64)
3. Front Runner (65–99)
4. Achiever (100).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Is index mein top aur bottom states kaun rehte hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Top state generally Kerala rehta hai aur bottom par Bihar, Jharkhand jate hain (halanki Bihar ka score year-on-year fastest grow kar raha hai).

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) NITI Aayog release karta hai based on NFHS data. Isme 3 Dimensions aur 12 Indicators hote hain:
• Health (Nutrition, Child-Adolescent Mortality, Maternal Health)
• Education (Years of Schooling, Attendance)
• Standard of Living (Cooking Fuel, Sanitation, Drinking Water, Electricity, Housing, Assets, Bank Accounts).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Bihar ke context mein MPI ka kya report hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: ⭐ Bihar mein Multidimensional Poverty mein sabse steep decline darj kiya gaya hai — croro log poverty se bahar nikle hain!

quiz_payload.question: NITI Aayog ke National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) mein kitne sanketak (indicators) shamil hain?
quiz_payload.explanation: Global MPI mein 10 indicators hote hain, par NITI Aayog ke National MPI mein 12 indicators hain (Maternal Health aur Bank Accounts ko India-specific add kiya gaya hai).

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
SSC aur BPSC ke liye NITI Aayog ke saare major indices ki list yaad rakho:
• India Innovation Index
• Export Preparedness Index (EPI)
• State Energy & Climate Index (SECI)
• Composite Water Management Index (CWMI)
• School Education Quality Index (SEQI)
• State Health Index.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Export Preparedness Index mein coastal states top karte honge na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan, Gujarat, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra top karte hain. Landlocked states mein alag ranking nikali jaati hai.

summary_payload.title: ⚖️ Planning Commission vs NITI Aayog: Complete Comparison

revision_points.point: PC: Top-Down (Centralized) | NITI: Bottom-Up (Decentralized)
PC: Allocated funds to Ministries & States | NITI: Advisory only (FinMin allocates)
PC: States were spectators in NDC | NITI: CMs are direct members of Governing Council
PC: Rigid 5-Year target plans | NITI: 15-Yr Vision, 7-Yr Strategy, 3-Yr Action
PC: Large full-time body | NITI: Limited full-time + Part-time + Ex-officio ministers
Dono hi Extra-Constitutional / Non-Statutory hain (Formed by Cabinet Resolution)

quiz_payload.question: Planning Commission aur NITI Aayog ke sandarbh mein kaun sa kathan ASATYA (Incorrect) hai?

options.text: Dono ka gathan Mantrimandal ke sankalp (Cabinet Resolution) se hua.
Planning Commission ke paas rajyon ko fund aavantit karne ki shakti thi.
NITI Aayog ke paas Five Year Plans banane ki vaidh shakti hai.
NITI Aayog ki Governing Council mein sabhi Chief Ministers shamil hain.

quiz_payload.explanation: Kathan C asatya hai kyunki NITI Aayog Five-Year Plans nahi banata, balki 15-Year Vision aur Strategy documents taiyar karta hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
⭐ BPSC Special Module: Bihar State Planning Board (Bihar Rajya Yojna Parishad) ka gathan rajya ki vikas yojnayein aur sansadhan aavantan evaluate karne ke liye kiya gaya.
• Chairman: Chief Minister of Bihar
• Vice-Chairman: Appointed Planning Expert / Minister
• Member Secretary: Planning Department Secretary.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: District level par planning kaun karta hai Bihar mein?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Article 243ZD ke antargat 'District Planning Committee' (DPC) har district mein banti hai, jiska kaam Panchayats aur Municipalities ke plans ko consolidate karna hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Constitution ke Article 243-I (Panchayats) aur Article 243-Y (Municipalities) ke tehat har 5 saal mein State Governor 'State Finance Commission' banate hain. Iska kaam State ke net tax revenue ko Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs) aur Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) mein distribute karna hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ye Central Finance Commission se kaise alag hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Central FC (Article 280) Centre aur States ke beech batwara karti hai; State FC State aur uske Gaon/Shahron ke beech!

quiz_payload.question: ⭐ Bihar Rajya Vitta Aayog (State Finance Commission) ka gathan samvidhan ke kis anuchhed ke tehat Governor dwara kiya jata hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Article 243-I (Panchayato ke liye) aur 243-Y (Nagarpalikao ke liye) ke tehat Governor dwara har 5 varsh par State Finance Commission ka gathan kiya jata hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
⭐ Saat Nischay-1 (2015–2020) ke 7 components BPSC me poore match karne aate hain:
1. Aarthik Hal, Yuvaon ko Bal (Student Credit Card, Kaushal Vikas, Swayam Sahayata Bhatta)
2. Aarakshit Rozgar, Mahilaon ka Adhikar (35% reservation for women in govt jobs)
3. Har Ghar Bijli Lagataar
4. Har Ghar Nal ka Jal
5. Ghar Tak Pakki Gali-Naliyan
6. Shauchalay Nirman, Ghar ka Samman
7. Awsar Badhe, Aage Padhe.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Har Ghar Nal ka Jal to national level par Jal Jeevan Mission ka inspiration bana!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Exact! Bihar ke model ko Centre ne Jal Jeevan Mission ke roop mein replicate kiya.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
⭐ Saat Nischay-2 (2020–2025) ke 7 naye targets rat lo:
1. Yuva Shakti — Bihar ki Pragati (ITI/Polytechnic upgradation, Mega Skill Centres)
2. Sashakt Mahila — Saksham Mahila (Udyami Yojana for women, 12th pass 25k, Grad pass 50k)
3. Har Khet Tak Sinchai ka Pani
4. Swachh Gaon — Samriddh Gaon (Solar street lights, solid waste management)
5. Swachh Shahar — Viksit Shahar (Storm drainage, Vridhjan aashray)
6. Sulabh Samparkata (Bypass aur flyovers connectivity)
7. Sabke Liye Swasthya Suvidha (Telemedicine, Bal Hriday Yojana).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Bal Hriday Yojana mein kya hota hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Hole in the heart (dil mein chhed) se pidit bachhon ka free treatment aur operation Ahmedabad/Patna mein karwaya jata hai.

quiz_payload.question: ⭐ Bihar sarkar ke 'Saat Nischay-2' (2020-2025) mein nimnlikhit mein se kaun sa component shamil NAHI hai?

options.text: Har Khet Tak Sinchai ka Pani

quiz_payload.explanation: 'Har Ghar Bijli Lagataar' Saat Nischay-1 (2015-20) ka hissa tha jo 100% achieve ho gaya. Saat Nischay-2 mein 'Har Khet Tak Sinchai ka Pani', 'Yuva Shakti', 'Sashakt Mahila', aadi hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
BPSC/BSSC ke liye aur major Bihar planned schemes:
• Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana (Birth se Graduation tak 54,100 total assistance)
• Bihar Udyami Yojana (SC/ST/EBC/Youth/Women ko 10 Lakh loan/grant for industries)
• Jal-Jeevan-Hariyali Abhiyan (Oct 2019 launch — climate resilience, tree planting & pond rejuvenation)
• Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme (4 Lakh education loan at nominal/zero interest).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Jal-Jeevan-Hariyali Abhiyan ka human chain event bhi bana tha na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! World record human chain bani thi awareness ke liye.

quiz_payload.question: ⭐ Bihar mein Jal-Jeevan-Hariyali Abhiyan ki shuruaat kab ki gayi thi?
quiz_payload.explanation: Jal-Jeevan-Hariyali Abhiyan 2 October 2019 ko Gandhi Jayanti ke avasar par launch kiya gaya tha, jiska mukhya uddeshya climate change mitigation aur water conservation hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Bihar State Planning ke dynamic data points (BPSC mains & prelims):
• GSDP Growth Rate: India ke top growing states mein se ek.
• Primary Sector (Agriculture): Growth driven by Krishi Roadmaps (Krishi Roadmap 1, 2, 3 aur ab Krishi Roadmap-4 2023-2028 active hai!).
• Tertiary Sector (Services): GSDP mein sabse bada share holds karta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Krishi Roadmap-4 ka focus area kya hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Crop diversification, organic farming along Ganga corridor, millets (Shri Anna) aur storage/processing infrastructure!

quiz_payload.question: ⭐ Bihar sarkar dwara 'Chautha Krishi Roadmap' (Krishi Roadmap-4) kis samayavadhi (period) ke liye lagu kiya gaya hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Bihar Krishi Roadmap-4 ki samayavadhi 2023 se 2028 tak hai. Iska launch President Droupadi Murmu dwara kiya gaya tha.

navigation.button_text: Centrally Sponsored vs Central Sector Schemes ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
UPSC/BPSC Conceptual Question: Schemes do types ki hoti hain:
1. Central Sector Schemes: 100% funding Union Govt deti hai aur Central machinery execute karti hai (e.g., PM-KISAN, Namami Gange).
2. Centrally Sponsored Schemes (CSS): Funding share hoti hai Centre aur State ke beech (e.g., 60:40 or 90:10 for Northeast/Hilly), execution State karti hai (e.g., MGNREGA, Samagra Shiksha).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: NITI Aayog ne CSS schemes ko rationalize bhi kiya tha na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan, Shivraj Singh Chouhan sub-committee on CSS ki recommendation par inko 'Core of the Core', 'Core', aur 'Optional' schemes mein categorize kiya gaya.

quiz_payload.question: Nimnlikhit mein se kaun si 'Central Sector Scheme' (Kendriya Kshetra Yojna) ka udaharan hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: PM-KISAN ek 100% Central Sector Scheme hai jisme poora paisa Central Govt direct benefit transfer (DBT) ke roop mein bhejti hai. Anya vikalp Centrally Sponsored Schemes (CSS) hain.

quiz_payload.question:
Assertion (A): NITI Aayog promotes competitive federalism along with cooperative federalism among Indian states.

Reason (R): It releases ranking indices like SDG India Index and Export Preparedness Index to benchmark performance.

Which of the following is correct?

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

quiz_payload.explanation: Both statements are TRUE. Ranking states transparently through indices is the exact mechanism by which competitive federalism is fostered.

quiz_payload.question:
⭐ Assertion (A): Bihar and other financially stressed states frequently advocate for more untied fiscal transfers rather than rigid conditional Centrally Sponsored Schemes.

Reason (R): State Planning Boards have full constitutional authority under Article 280 to overrule Central Finance Commission recommendations.

Which of the following is correct?

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

quiz_payload.explanation: Assertion is TRUE (States want flexibility to tailor funds to local needs). Reason is FALSE (Article 280 governs the Central Finance Commission, and State Planning Boards have no authority to overrule it).

quiz_payload.question:
Consider the following statements regarding NITI Aayog:
1. The Vice-Chairperson is appointed by the Prime Minister and holds the rank of Cabinet Minister.
2. The CEO of NITI Aayog holds the rank of Secretary to the Government of India.
3. The Governing Council includes the Chief Ministers of all states and Lieutenant Governors of Union Territories.
4. NITI Aayog has the statutory authority to impose financial penalties on underperforming states.

How many of the above statements are CORRECT?
quiz_payload.explanation: Statements 1, 2, and 3 are CORRECT. Statement 4 is INCORRECT because NITI Aayog is an advisory body and possesses no statutory or punitive powers.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
BPSC TRE (Teacher Recruitment) ke repeated points:
• DPC (District Planning Committee) ka article: Article 243ZD
• Metropolitan Planning Committee (MPC): Article 243ZE
• Planning kis List mein aati hai? 7th Schedule ki CONCURRENT LIST (Item 20: Economic and Social Planning) mein aati hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Concurrent List matlab Centre aur State dono laws bana sakte hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Isliye Centre (Planning Commission/NITI) aur State (State Planning Board) dono operate karte hain.

quiz_payload.question: Bhartiya Samvidhan ki 7th Schedule mein 'Aarthik aur Samajik Yojna' (Economic and Social Planning) kis soochi (list) ka vishay hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Economic and Social Planning Concurrent List (Samvarti Soochi) ke Entry 20 par darj hai, jisme Parliament aur State Legislatures dono ko adhikar hai.

quiz_payload.question: SSC CGL PYQ: Who was the Prime Minister of India when the Planning Commission was formally dissolved in 2014?
quiz_payload.explanation: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced the dissolution in August 2014 from the Red Fort, followed by official notification replacing it on 1 January 2015.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Planning ka sabse practical tool State Budget hota hai. 2017 mein Centre aur Bihar sarkar ne 'Plan vs Non-Plan Expenditure' classification ko khatam karke 'Revenue vs Capital Expenditure' aur 'Scheme vs Establishment Expenditure' adopt kiya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Is badlav ka kya fayda hua?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Accounting transparent hui aur asset-creating 'Capital Outlay' (roads, bridges, schools) par clear monitoring hone lagi.

quiz_payload.question:
⭐ GRAND UPSC/BPSC CHALLENGE (Match All):

Match the following pairs correctly:
1. National Planning Committee (1938) — (a) Subhash Chandra Bose & Nehru
2. People's Plan (1945) — (b) M.N. Roy
3. Atal Innovation Mission — (c) NITI Aayog
4. Saat Nischay Programme — (d) Bihar Government

Which code is correct?
quiz_payload.explanation: All 4 pairs are correctly matched in their direct chronological and administrative correspondence.

quiz_payload.question: Which of the following statements regarding the evolution of planning in India is INCORRECT?

options.text: The First Five-Year Plan achieved a higher growth rate than its targeted growth.
The Planning Commission was established under Article 39(b) and 39(c) as a constitutional body.
The concept of 'Inclusive Growth' was formally introduced in the 11th Five-Year Plan.
NITI Aayog does not possess the mandate to allocate central plan funds to state governments.

quiz_payload.explanation: Statement B is INCORRECT. While DPSP Articles 39(b) and (c) guided its socio-economic philosophy, the Planning Commission was NOT a constitutional body; it was created by an executive resolution.
